example_prompt: Check whether a SasPay checkout session was paid before fulfilling the order.
gotchas: SasPay has no working sandbox: an sk_test_ key reaches the same production API as a live key. SasPay's support answered « les clés sandbox ne sont pas fonctionnelles, veuillez utiliser les clés lives » after a card payment made with such a key was debited for real (maintainer's test and ticket of 2026-11-01, reply read 2026-11-07; details in create_checkout_session). This call reads or changes production data. The verification recorded on this spec (environment: sandbox) was run with an sk_test_ key on 2026-10-17: that label is what test:live records for such a key, not proof of a separate test environment; the API answered normally, and whether such a key moves money on mobile money is not known.
Meant for polling when no webhook is configured: it re-checks the real gateway state on each call.
Authenticated calls are limited to 300 requests per minute per account; beyond that the API returns 429, so space out polling.

`success: true` only means the call worked; the outcome is in data.status (PAID for a paid session; session statuses PENDING | PAID | EXPIRED | CANCELLED) and data.transaction_status (SUCCESS for the payment; transaction statuses PENDING | SUCCESS | FAILED | CANCELLED).

spans: À utiliser en polling si vous n'avez pas encore de webhook configuré.
Les appels authentifiés (clé API ou dashboard) sont limités à **300 requêtes par minute** par compte par défaut.
